title: Rigorous and effective numerics for Liverani-Saussol-Vaienti maps
summary: We make highly accurate numerical estimates of basic properties of the invariant measure for Liverani-Saussol-Vaienti intermittent maps, an archetypal slowly mixing dynamical system. We solve the challenge of precise and efficient estimation for a map with non-uniform expansion, where the transfer operator does not have a spectral gap. We do this using an Abel function, which solves the neutral dynamics, and which we can compute accurately via an asymptotic expansion.
